Subject: Request: PR approval trail + CI transcript for SIG questionnaire (Finovate)

Hi Naomi —

Thanks for agreeing to support Finovate's SIG review. To complete the SDLC controls section we need: 
- chronological PR approval evidence for the three production changes between 2026-05-01 and 2026-05-25 (approver identities + timestamps)
- the CI/CD run transcript for the production deployment on 2026-05-18 (full stdout/stderr)
- confirmation of the KMS key rotation window and last rotation artifact (Q1 2026)

If you can provide these artifacts or a pointer to a package by EOD June 14 that would be ideal. We may follow up with a few clarifying questions once we review.

Best,
Alyssa Cheng
Senior Assessor, CloudAssess LLC

Date: Thu, 11 Jun 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: PR approval trail + CI transcript for SIG questionnaire (Finovate)

Alyssa —

Thanks for the list. We're packaging the artifacts now. Quick notes up front: 
- PR approval trail exported from our code host includes approver id, approval timestamp, and merge SHA; see attached pr-approval-log-2026-05.csv (redacted tester accounts).
- CI/CD transcript attached (ci-run-20260518-stdout.log). This is the full raw run for the 2026-05-18 prod rollout; it includes the deployment roll command, integration test run, and artifact promotion steps.
- KMS rotation audit (kms-rotation-report-2026Q1.pdf) shows rotation completed 2026-03-28; we retain rotation logs for 2 years per policy.
- We also ran a quick SCA on the release and captured the summary (sca-report-summary.zip).

I'll leave Jordan and Karthik on the thread for any technical clarifications. If you need a signed attestation or a bundle in a different format (DocuSign/secure share), let me know.

Attachments: pr-approval-log-2026-05.csv (CSV), ci-run-20260518-stdout.log (text), kms-rotation-report-2026Q1.pdf (pdf), sca-report-summary.zip (zip)

Thanks,
Naomi

Redwood Inference
From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>

Date: Mon, 14 Jun 2026 09:28:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: PR approval trail + CI transcript for SIG questionnaire (Finovate)

Alyssa —

One clarification on the PR log: the CSV shows three merges matching your date range. For each PR we include: author, reviewers, approval timestamp (UTC), and the merge operator. For the middle change (PR #3421) there was a brief approval exception from a release manager during a hotfix window — you'll see the exception_note column populated. Quick excerpt below:

> PR #3421, merged at 2026-05-12T14:07:33Z, approvals: [karthik_iyer, marissa_cole], exception_note: release-manager-override by marcus_lin (audit ticket SEC-4289)

On CI transcript: the deployment step uses ephemeral credentials injected via our ephemeral-agent service (token TTL 10m). The transcript includes a short notice block when the ephemeral token was minted: "[INFO] ephemeral-agent: token issued id=ea-9f3c ttl=600s" — that line is redacted in the attached log for PII/credentials.

If you need the exact audit ticket reference, see JIRA SEC-4289 (linked in related_links).

-Jordan
Sr. Engineering Manager, Platform
Redwood Inference
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Alyssa Cheng <alyssa.cheng@cloudassess.com>
Cc: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 14 Jun 2026 16:44:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: PR approval trail + CI transcript for SIG questionnaire (Finovate)

Alyssa —

Following up with the secrets/rotation detail you asked about. Short answers: 
- KMS rotation cadence: quarterly for master keys (automated, with manual approval for KMS key material rotation); last automated rotation completed 2026-03-28 as Naomi attached.
- Ephemeral agent tokens: TTL = 10 minutes; issuance is logged to our audit pipeline and retained for 90 days in the audit index (we've included the index query and a small excerpt in the S3 artifact referenced in the Drive link).
- PR gating and code review: we enforce 2 independent approvers for production-targeted PRs unless an emergency override is used (exceptions are logged and require post-merge remediation). The CSV includes the approvals_count and exception_note columns for transparency.

If CloudAssess wants a short signed statement confirming these controls (one paragraph, signed by Security), I can produce that and route through Naomi for signature.

Regards,
Karthik Iyer
Director, Applied Security
Redwood Inference
